proof_body:
by
  intro p hp
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_ne p.2.1 (fun h => hp (Subtype.ext h.symm))
  set q : ℝ := 1 - (p : ℝ) with hq
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by rw [hq]; linarith [p.2.2]
  have hq1 : q < 1 := by rw [hq]; linarith
  have hn : ‖q‖ < 1 := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
  have hpq : (p : ℝ) = 1 - q := by rw [hq]; ring
  have h1 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => q ^ n * (p : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)) (q / (p : ℝ)) := by
    have := (hasSum_coe_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hn).mul_right (p : ℝ)
    have hv : q / (p : ℝ) = q / (1 - q) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ) := by rw [← hpq]; field_simp
    rw [hv]
    refine Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f : ℕ → ℝ => HasSum f _) (funext fun n => ?_)) this
    ring
  have hch : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 2).choose 2 : ℝ) * q ^ n) (1 / (1 - q) ^ (2 + 1)) := hasSum_choose_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 2 hn
  have h3 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => q ^ n * (p : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))) (2 * q ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    rw [← hasSum_nat_add_iff' 2]
    simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty]
    norm_num
    have := hch.mul_left (2 * q ^ 2 * (p : ℝ))
    have hv : 2 * q ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2 = 2 * q ^ 2 * (p : ℝ) * (1 / (1 - q) ^ (2 + 1)) := by rw [← hpq]; field_simp
    rw [hv]
    refine Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f : ℕ → ℝ => HasSum f _) (funext fun n => ?_)) this
    have hc : ((n + 2).choose 2 : ℝ) = ((n : ℝ) + 2) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) / 2 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_choose_two]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hc]
    push_cast
    ring
  have h4 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => q ^ n * (p : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) (2 * q ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2 + q / (p : ℝ)) := by
    refine Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f : ℕ → ℝ => HasSum f _) (funext fun n => ?_)) (h3.add h1)
    ring
  have hint1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) := by
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.integrable_geometricMeasure_iff hp]
    simpa only [Real.norm_natCast] using h1.summable
  have hint2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ 2) (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) := by
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.integrable_geometricMeasure_iff hp]
    simpa only [norm_pow, Real.norm_natCast] using h4.summable
  have hL : MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) :=
    (MeasureTheory.memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.of_discrete)).mpr hint2
  have e1 := ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_integral_geometricMeasure hp hint1
  have e2 := ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_integral_geometricMeasure hp hint2
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at e1 e2
  have e1' := e1.unique h1
  have e2' := e2.unique h4
  refine ⟨hL, e1', ?_⟩
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_sub hL]
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
  rw [e1', e2']
  have hq2 : q = 1 - (p : ℝ) := rfl
  field_simp
  rw [hq2]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (p : unitInterval), p ≠ 0 → MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) ∧ ∫ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ∂(ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) = (1 - (p : ℝ)) / (p : ℝ) ∧ ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) = (1 - (p : ℝ)) / (p : ℝ) ^ 2
